facts.fact: The course is named for George Wright, shortstop of the 1869 Cincinnati Red Stockings and a Hall of Famer, who with three friends cut nine holes in Franklin Park in December 1890.
Donald Ross course built by the WPA, opened 1938, owned by the City of Boston.

concepts.name: The Stitched Ball
concepts.rationale: A golf ball sewn with a baseball's red stitching, sitting on a scarlet oak leaf.
concepts.strengths: One subject, no background, in the house style (developer 2026-10-25: no circular badges).
